query.title: Company name or registration number
query.description: A single business/company name (or partial name) or CIPA registration number (e.g. BW00000015806) to search for.

queries.title: Company names or registration numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/registration numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

entityType.title: Entity type filter
entityType.description: Restrict results to one register entity type. "Any" searches across all types.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full company profile
fetchDetails.description: When on (default), each matched entity is opened to pull its full public profile -- addresses, directors, secretary, shareholders, auditor, beneficial owners. When off, only the search-result summary (name, registration number, status, entity type) is returned, which is faster for a broad name search.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities to return (and, if enabled, fetch full profiles for) per search query.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search sessions / detail-page fetches to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
